per_object_cap.notes: extracted from the quota or limits prose

retention.stated: no retention statement was extracted from the seed's quota and limits prose; absence here is a gap in this conversion, not a vendor claim that retention is unlimited
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: No egress metering documented; free plan caps "Daily Opens" at 30,000/day and readers can download the PDF; flipbooks are served from online.anyflip.com with a per-page HTML reader. Free tier embeds an AnyFlip watermark in the embed.

tooling: No public API; upload is the web form at anyflip.com/quick-upload/ (POST without a session 302s to /login.php). Flipbook pages are static per-page HTML at online.anyflip.com/<a>/<b>/files/basic-html/pageN.html so a downloader can be written, but there is no upload client.
chaining: Unlimited free accounts x 100 GB each. Rate is the binding constraint, not storage: 5 uploads/day x 150 MB = 750 MB/day/account, so 10 TiB/month needs ~450 accounts uploading daily; 20 TiB archive needs ~900.
limits_note: 150 MB per PDF; 5 uploads/day free (60/day Pro); 30,000 daily opens; 100 GB cap; watermark on free embeds; download of the source PDF is plan-gated in practice.

identity_cost.detail: no identity_cost field and no identity statement in the source record; defaulted to email and flagged, not evidence

reliability_note: Originals are re-served as derived page images, and the free download path returns 403 without a session; content is publicly listed, so anything put here is discoverable.
